description: Live full collection of the GovCloud staging account (us-gov-west-1 and us-gov-east-1, 898 manifest entries, partition aws-us-gov) with the real Boto3Collector.run(), the collector's read-only identity and the read guard installed, writing to the local grid only. Run 1 on main 34267db; run 2 on the fix for aws-core-tap#213 (main + 65fdcce). Counts, codes and booleans only; no account number, resource id or message.
script: not committed: a scratch wrapper around Boto3Collector.run() like tools/validate/selection_live.py, with no include_types, that also captures the submitted GRIFT document for counts and a secret-material scan
verdict: fail on main, pass with the aws-core-tap#213 fix

checks.the batch imports: run 1: rejected whole (GriftRejectedError, 'Value must be valid JSON' on an aws_iot_domain_configuration node; cause: a raw datetime at configuration._hydrate.detail.data.lastStatusChangeDate on 4 of 4 such nodes, found by a one-type probe that submitted nothing); run 2: imported, 0 import errors
checks.no secret material is stored: run 2: 9 matching paths in 1687 nodes, none secret material: access key IDs as IAM user tag keys and as Security Hub finding resource ids (identifiers, not secrets), a GitHub OIDC trust-policy condition key and two EC2 settings matched on name only. Patterns are limited: a negative result, not proof

trials.note: The plugin checkout was switched to another branch partway through this run; modules were mostly loaded and the failure is unrelated, but it is not cited as a measurement. The harness exited on the rejection, so no ledger counts were kept.

not_checked: that pre-existing empty values are rewritten to null: the grid on this host was fresh, with no older rows
the 116 DUPLICATE_IDENTITY warnings (aws_ram_permission, 111 nodes, is a guess at the source, not verified)
a per-region split of calls: the call ledger records no region
ECS: the account held no ECS resources
method: Both runs are the same harness; run 2 catches a rejected batch so its counts survive one. Call counts and outcomes are the run's AWS_CALL_LEDGER; node, edge and secret-scan figures are read from the GRIFT document the collector submitted (what is stored). Output was scrubbed of 12-digit numbers and ARNs before it was read.
